ItemID: 1; Title: NEIKO 01407A Electronic Digital Caliper Measuring Tool, 0 - 6 Inches Stainless Steel Construction with Large LCD Screen Quick Change Button for Inch Fraction Millimeter Conversions, Digital Caliper Measuring Tool; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Useful for checking component dimensions and clearances in my electronics and workshop projects.
ItemID: 2; Title: NEIKO 50432A Hex Nut Assortment Set | 150 Pc Nylon Locking Nuts | A3 Steel Hex Assorted Hardware Kit #10 & SAE | Metal Screw Nut for Bolts | Friction Lock Nut; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would need a specific mounting project and matching bolt sizes before choosing this assortment.

ItemID: 4; Title: J-B Weld Original Epoxy, Steel Reinforced Epoxy, High Strength - 2 Pack, Dark Grey (8265S-2); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not have a specific repair in mind that calls for steel-reinforced epoxy right now.

ItemID: 8; Title: J-B Weld 8277 WaterWeld Epoxy Putty Stick - 2 oz., Off White; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent projects do not suggest a current need for a water-related repair putty.
